<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917104_theRebbe_810" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917104_theRebbe_810__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening header and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbat Parshat Bo,</t>
    <t s="2">8 Shevat,</t>
    <t s="3">5736*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the maamar is a discourse given by the Rebbe.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">(A discourse)</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the concept of the Shechinah descending through the righteous, the purpose of the Mishkan, and the service of offerings.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"I have come to My garden, My sister, My bride."</t>
    <t s="1">And the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Admor of the hillula, brings</t>
    <t s="2">[in the maamar</t>
    <t s="3">that was given by him for the day of his histalkus, Shabbat Parshat Bo, 10 Shevat,</t>
    <t s="4">5710]</t>
    <t s="5">the teaching of the Midrash:</t>
    <t s="6">"To My garden, to My orchard, to the place that was My primary dwelling initially,"</t>
    <t s="7">that the primary dwelling of the Shechinah was in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="8">but through undesirable matters during the course of seven generations, they removed the Shechinah from below upward until the seventh heaven,</t>
    <t s="9">and afterward the righteous arose and drew down the Shechinah from above downward,</t>
    <t s="10">and the beginning of the drawing down was from Avraham,</t>
    <t s="11">"Avraham was one,"</t>
    <t s="12">who brought it down from the seventh heaven to the sixth, etc., until Moshe, who is the seventh, and all sevenths are beloved,</t>
    <t s="13">brought it down below to earth.</t>
    <t s="14">And this is why the making of the Mishkan was through Moshe</t>
    <t s="15">(specifically),</t>
    <t s="16">for the concept of the Mishkan is as it is stated,</t>
    <t s="17">"And they shall make Me a Sanctuary, and I will dwell in their midst,"</t>
    <t s="18">that through "And they shall make Me a Sanctuary," there is brought about "And I will dwell" below, within the children of Israel and within the world,</t>
    <t s="19">for from the indwelling of the Shechinah that was in the Holy Temple, the revelation was drawn through the windows that are "transparent yet sealed"</t>
    <t s="20">throughout the entire world.</t>
    <t s="21">And all this was accomplished through the service of Israel, and as our Sages, of blessed memory, precisely stated,</t>
    <t s="22">"It does not say 'within it,' but rather 'within them'—within each and every one of Israel,"</t>
    <t s="23">that through the service of Israel</t>
    <t s="24">(and "Your people are all righteous")</t>
    <t s="25">there is brought about "And I will dwell" in the Mishkan, and through this, in the entire world.</t>
    <t s="26">And this is [the meaning of] "The righteous shall inherit the land and dwell upon it forever,"</t>
    <t s="27">that "the righteous shall inherit the land," which is the Land of Life</t>
    <t s="28">(the Garden of Eden),</t>
    <t s="29">because they cause to dwell and draw down</t>
    <t s="30">the aspect of "Shochein" (the Indwelling One),</t>
    <t s="31">the aspect of "Ad" (eternity),</t>
    <t s="32">the aspect of the "Sovev" (the Encompassing),</t>
    <t s="33">so that it will be revealed below through the service of Torah and mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="34">And as it is stated,</t>
    <t s="35">"I made the earth and created man upon it,"</t>
    <t s="36">that this</t>
    <t s="37">[is what is meant by] "I made the earth"—it is for the sake of man, and the creation of man is for the sake of "Bereisi" (I created him), which in gematria equals 613,</t>
    <t s="38">meaning that through the fulfillment of the 613 mitzvos, the intention of creation is completed—that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place in the lower realms.</t>
    <t s="39">And this is why one of the services that was in the Temple was the matter of the service of the offerings,</t>
    <t s="40">for the service of the offerings is a spiritual service within the soul of man,</t>
    <t s="41">and as the Alter Rebbe precisely explains</t>
    <t s="42">regarding the verse,</t>
    <t s="43">"When a man from among you brings an offering," etc., that the offering must be from you, literally,</t>
    <t s="44">from the animal soul within man,</t>
    <t s="45">and it says about this, "from the cattle and from the flock,"</t>
    <t s="46">these are the specific levels that exist in the animal soul</t>
    <t s="47">(and as explained in many places</t>
    <t s="48">regarding the matter of ox, sheep, and goat).</t>
    <t s="49">And this service was in the Temple,</t>
    <t s="50">for all ascents are through the Temple.</t>
    <t s="51">For just as all the draw-downs are through the Temple,</t>
    <t s="52">and as above, that the drawing down of the Shechinah into the world was through the "transparent yet sealed" windows of the Temple,</t>
    <t s="53">so too, the ascents from below upward are through the Temple,</t>
    <t s="54">therefore, when one prays, he should direct his intention toward the Holy Temple.</t>
    <t s="55">And based on this, he explains there why the Mishkan was made of acacia wood,</t>
    <t s="56">for the primary service of man is the matter of subjugation and transformation of darkness into light,</t>
    <t s="57">and therefore the Mishkan was made of acacia wood,</t>
    <t s="58">which is an expression of foolishness,</t>
    <t s="59">the transformation of the foolishness of the side of impurity that is below the intellectual realm,</t>
    <t s="60">[for] a person does not commit a transgression unless a spirit of foolishness enters into him,</t>
    <t s="61">into the foolishness of holiness that is above the intellectual realm.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
